alt_text: “The foundation upon which American democracy has been built is the right to vote. … Now it seems the Executive Branch of the United States government wants to abridge the right of many Americans to cast their ballots.” - California federal Judge David O. Carter, Bill Clinton appointee

author: propublica.org
alt_text: “The United States’ championing of its claims under the [election laws] ... can only be described as halfhearted. And for good reason, since neither statute gives the United States the power to compel Maine to produce its current [unredacted voter list]." - Maine federal Judge Lance E. Walker, Trump appointee
